note: NECO Geography round 2 (Round 18 lift): fresh earth items (meridians, 15 degrees = 1 hour, eastward time, revolution-seasons, equinoxes), river work (waterfall on resistant rock, meander, ox-bow, levees, youthful V-valleys, delta build-up), map skills (grid references, crossing contours at cliffs, area by squares), population (density formula, natural increase, brain drain, overcrowding, NPC), economic (Enugu coal, associated gas, Shiroro-Jebba, timber belt, northern irrigation), regional (Ibadan-Oyo, Port Harcourt, Maiduguri, Guinea savanna, oil palm, Jos potatoes), instruments (rain gauge, wind vane, Stevenson screen, laterites) and environment (carbon dioxide, contour ploughing, oil spillage, deforestation). Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the JAMB Geography banks.
